data.name: Twilight Gallery
data.detailed_description:
EXPERIENCE

You wake up in the parking lot of a surreal art gallery with no memory of how you got there, You begin to feel watched as you solve puzzles hidden within surreal art exhibits in order to find out who made this facility and escape. Navigating fixed camera scenes, your logic will be tested by interactive exhibits as you adorn a helmet with a magical visor to discover clues in order to escape.

Created through a mix of hand-painted artwork and 3D rendering, the gallery ambiance is one of nostalgic fantasy and unsettling liminality. Twilight Gallery invites you to slow down, explore at your own pace, and exercise your mind.

GAMEPLAY

-Classic point-and-click adventure gameplay with fixed camera views

-Handcrafted environmental puzzles focused on observation, logic, and experimentation

-Inventory-based interactions, including objects that can be temporarily manipulated or combined with the environment

-Animated cursor feedback to intuitively guide exploration

-14 unique puzzles, with many puzzle elements randomized between playthroughs

-Automatic saving, allowing players to freely explore without repeating progress

-An average 1-2 hour playtime, with replayability through puzzle variation

Story, art, music, sound design, and game design by James Ryan Walker.

data.short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game inspired by flash games of the early internet. Escape a dream-like gallery using a magic helm to look for clues and uncover how you got here.
